svg.aria-label: Misregistration artifact against blend ramp width, one panel per ramp shape
svg.text: Experiment 2 — does soft blending buy geometric tolerance?
PROVISIONAL — every photometric constant behind this figure is class ASSUME and none has been measured.
Cell colour: peak luminance error the misregistration causes, |Y - Y_calibrated| / Y_calibrated, on a flat mid-gray field.
Contours mark where that reaches §7's seam gates — which gate a STEP, not a band (A-15), so they are a scale and not a verdict.

svg.text: Verdict: the hypothesis HOLDS in this model — over w_width's 5-40° range the tolerable registration error rises 8.34×, and stops improving past 60°.

Same rig, same knob, one axis at a time. The artifact is a point-for-point difference between two renders of ONE physical rig — with and without a correct calibration — so no window, polynomial or scale enters it.
